about: Shared review_user_story cases. Generated from k11 Playwright QA's implementation; both Playwright QA and Selenium QA must produce exactly these questions.

cases.name: clear story
cases.story:
As a registered customer, I want to sign in so that I can see my orders.

Scenario: Valid credentials show the dashboard
  Given I am on the login page
  When I sign in with valid credentials
  Then I see "Welcome back"

Scenario: Wrong password shows an error
  Given I am on the login page
  When I sign in with a wrong password
  Then I see an error message

cases.name: one-line wish
cases.story: I want the search to be fast and easy to use.

questions.question: What are the acceptance criteria? List what must be true for this story to be done.
Who is the user: a visitor, a signed-in customer, an admin? Does anyone else get different behaviour?
"fast" can't be tested as written. What is the measurable version (a number, a time, a specific behaviour)?
questions.quote: I want the search to be fast and easy to use.

questions.question: "easy" can't be tested as written. What is the measurable version (a number, a time, a specific behaviour)?
questions.quote: I want the search to be fast and easy to use.

cases.name: vague outcome, asked once
cases.story:
As a shopper, I want to apply a discount code.
Scenario: code applies
  Given I have items in my cart
  When I enter a valid code
  Then the discount works correctly
Scenario: bad code
  Given I have items in my cart
  When I enter an invalid code
  Then I see "Code not recognised"

questions.question: In "code applies", what exactly shows that it worked: a message, a page, a value, an email?

cases.name: limit without a number
cases.story:
As an admin, I want to invite teammates.
Scenario: invite sent
  Given I am signed in as an admin
  When I invite a teammate by email
  Then I see "Invitation sent"
Scenario: invalid email
  Given I am signed in as an admin
  When I invite "not-an-email"
  Then I see an error message
Invitations expire after a while.

questions.question: What is the actual number for this limit, and what happens exactly at it and one past it?

cases.name: limit with a number
cases.story:
As a registered customer, I want to sign in so that I can see my orders.

Scenario: Valid credentials show the dashboard
  Given I am on the login page
  When I sign in with valid credentials
  Then I see "Welcome back"

Scenario: Wrong password shows an error
  Given I am on the login page
  When I sign in with a wrong password
  Then I see an error message
Accounts lock after 5 attempts.

cases.name: happy path only
cases.story:
As a customer, I want to download my invoice.
Scenario: download
  Given I have a paid order
  When I click "Download invoice"
  Then a PDF downloads

questions.question: What should happen when it goes wrong: invalid input, no permission, an expired session, a server error?

cases.name: missing precondition
cases.story:
As a customer, I want to cancel my order.
Scenario: cancel
  When I cancel my order
  Then I see "Order cancelled"
Scenario: too late
  Given my order has shipped
  When I try to cancel it
  Then I see an error message

questions.question: In "cancel", what is the starting state: who is signed in, and what data already exists?

cases.name: no Then
cases.story:
As a customer, I want to save my address.
Scenario: save
  Given I am on my profile
  When I save a new address
Scenario: missing postcode
  Given I am on my profile
  When I save an address without a postcode
  Then I see an error message

questions.question: In "save", what should the user see or what should change at the end?

cases.name: undefined term with context
cases.story:
As a Gold Member, I want free shipping on "Express Plus" orders.
- Gold Member orders over $50 show free shipping at checkout
- Orders without membership show the standard shipping price
cases.context: Gold Member: customers who spent over $500 last year.

questions.question: What should happen when it goes wrong: invalid input, no permission, an expired session, a server error?
What does "Express Plus" mean here? The context provided doesn't mention it.

cases.name: answered story (0.4.1 fix)
cases.story:
As a signed-in shopper, I want to apply a discount code at checkout.
Scenario: valid code
  Given I have a cart worth $80
  When I apply the code SAVE10
  Then I see "Discount: -$8.00"
Scenario: expired code
  Given I have a cart worth $80
  When I apply a code that expired 31 days ago
  Then I see "This code has expired"
